source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: For Singles pairing, the win path is the chronology of results. Take two players at 3–1. One recovered from an opening defeat with three wins. The other arrived at 3–0 before their setback. The first player might feel encouraged while the second is disappointed. Similar journeys give opponents a common experience to talk about. That approach can sometimes group players whose schedules were equally difficult.

fields.pairingGuidance: similar recent outcomes can improve rapport
